_comment: Athlete parameters that can't be derived from Garmin data. Anything left null is either measured from your own history or reported as unavailable -- nothing is guessed.
_nutrition_comment: Calorie targets are built from Garmin's MEASURED total daily energy expenditure (bmrKilocalories + activeKilocalories), not an estimated TDEE. Protein is held flat at protein_per_lb. Fat has a per-day floor in g/lb so it never drops to an unhealthy level; carbohydrate takes whatever calories are left, which is what makes hard days high-carb and easy days higher-fat automatically.
